app.register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Length matters more than symbols.
app.register.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. The account stays inactive until you follow it.
app.forgot.sent: If that address has an account here, we have sent it a link to set a new password. The link works for a limited time.
app.reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.
app.impersonate.failed: This support session could not be opened. Ask the operator to start it again.
app.dashboard.subtitle: Everything below is scoped to the workspace you are signed in to.
app.dashboard.modulesHint: Each one is a folder in frontend/app/modules and a folder in backend/src/Module.
app.dashboard.liveHint: Server-sent, scoped to this workspace's topic.
app.dashboard.liveEmptyHint: Create a project in another tab and it will appear here.
app.auth.headline: Your workspace, in order and within reach.
app.auth.tagline: Sign in to pick up where you left off.
app.login.title: Sign in
app.login.subtitle: Enter the email address and password of your account.
app.register.title: Create an account
app.register.subtitle: It takes a minute. At the end we will ask you to confirm your email address.
app.forgot.title: Forgot your password?
app.forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's email address and we will send a link to set a new password.
app.reset.title: Set a new password
